title: Disturbance of labyrinthine-vestibular function
summary: Disturbance of labyrinthine-vestibular function (including Meniere's disease), characterized by a history of frequent attacks of balance disturbance, tinnitus, and progressive hearing loss, with BOTH A) disturbed vestibular function on caloric/other vestibular tests AND B) hearing loss established by audiometry.

children.criterion: Disturbance of labyrinthine-vestibular function (including Meniere's disease), characterized by a history of frequent attacks of balance disturbance, tinnitus, and progressive loss of hearing
Disturbed function of vestibular labyrinth demonstrated by caloric or other vestibular tests
